title: BetaTelemetryDestinationTestFailure
description: The test span was not delivered.

error.description: A message that describes why the test span was not delivered, including the HTTP status code when the destination returned one. Examples: `HTTP error (status 403)`, `timeout`, `TLS failure`. It has the same form as the destination's `delivery_health.last_error` and never contains the destination's response body, any header value, a network address, or TLS details.
